newsitem.title: POLAND: Tax office rejects Universal refund claim.
newsitem.headline: Tax office rejects Universal refund claim.

text.p: The Polish tax authorities have rejected claims by trading firm Universal SA for 22 million zlotys in interest on overpaid taxes, the company's president said on Wednesday.
"We appealed the decision today and expect a response within 14 days," Dariusz Przywieczerski told Reuters.
Przywieczerski said the interest concerned overpaid taxes from 1989 to 1993.
Earlier this year Universal received interest refunds on overpaid taxes of 9.7 million zlotys and 6.3 million zlotys.
